balancing: Optimization-Based Balancing Weights for Causal Inference

Source: R/balancing-package.R
balancing-package.Rd

Calculates optimization-based balancing weights for causal inference, including entropy balancing, inverse probability tilting, the covariate balancing propensity score, energy balancing, characteristic function distance balancing, and stable balancing weights. Weights target covariate balance directly by solving a convex optimization problem, with support for binary, categorical, and continuous exposures across a range of causal estimands. A Rust core provides the numerical solvers.
